name: Kaiten Skills
description: Kaiten Skills is an online career-skills school for business writing, presenting and spreadsheets, founded in 2017 and taught from a studio in Utrecht. Courses are short video lessons you can buy in euros, with lesson 1 free to watch, 24 months of access and a certificate of completion. This block theme presents the courses, tutors, stories and checkout in a calm stone-and-ink layout.
